sloka: दयिताम् च विधेयम् च रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।सीतामादाय गच्छ त्वमग्रतो भरतानुज ॥२-५५-२७॥
transliteration: dayitām ca vidheyam ca rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt ।sītāmādāya gaccha tvamagrato bharatānuja ॥2-55-27॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, best among bipeds (men) and brother of Bharata walk ahead with Sita and I shall follow with weapons.
